subject.title: Skill steipete/bird: Homebrew formula download URL 404 (bird-macos-universal-v0.8.0.tar.gz)

question: Should `steipete/bird` become an explicit unavailable tombstone, remain a generic hidden 404, or redirect to a verified successor?
rationale: Production currently prevents installation, but neither repository history nor discussion establishes the intended permanent package-owner policy for the old slug.

options.title: Add unavailable tombstone
options.body: Keep downloads disabled while showing accurate unavailable metadata and a concise explanation that the upstream package was removed.

options.title: Keep generic 404
options.body: Retain the current hidden behavior if the owner confirms that the package was intentionally withdrawn without a successor.

options.title: Redirect to successor
options.body: Create an alias only after the owner verifies the canonical replacement and its working installation path.

recommendation.title: Add unavailable tombstone
recommendation.body: Keep downloads disabled while showing accurate unavailable metadata and a concise explanation that the upstream package was removed.

likelyOwner.reason: The package namespace and original upstream both belong to this owner, making them the strongest available authority on withdrawal or succession.
